title: Databases with Node.js Knowledge Check
description: Check your understanding of SQL and NoSQL access, PostgreSQL, connection pooling, transactions, migrations, and ORMs/query builders.
author: DailyCoder

questions.prompt: Why do production Node.js apps commonly use database connection pools?

options.text: To reuse a limited set of database connections efficiently
To store static images in JavaScript memory
To remove the need for queries

questions.explanation: Pools avoid creating a new database connection for every request and control concurrency.

questions.prompt: What is the main purpose of a transaction?

options.text: To make a group of database changes succeed or fail together

questions.explanation: Transactions protect consistency when multiple database operations must be atomic.

questions.prompt: What are database migrations used for?

options.text: Versioning and applying schema changes over time

questions.explanation: Migrations make schema changes trackable, reviewable, and repeatable across environments.

questions.prompt: What is an ORM or query builder meant to help with?

options.text: Structuring database access and queries in application code

questions.explanation: ORMs and query builders provide abstractions for modeling and querying data.
